cnn.selection: validation scores only; empirical false acceptance <=0.10; retake false rejection <=0.35
cnn.rate_denominators: False acceptance: all ungradable validation cases; false rejection: all gradable validation cases. Uncertain outputs are neither accepted nor rejected.
cnn.limits: Same validation set used for selection; only 23 ungradable cases. These are not held-out test rates or clinically validated safety targets.

quality_baseline.selection: validation scores only; empirical false acceptance <=0.10; retake false rejection <=0.35
quality_baseline.rate_denominators: False acceptance: all ungradable validation cases; false rejection: all gradable validation cases. Uncertain outputs are neither accepted nor rejected.
quality_baseline.limits: Same validation set used for selection; only 23 ungradable cases. These are not held-out test rates or clinically validated safety targets.

quality_thresholds.source: validation-image distribution: fixed 5th/95th percentiles and 99th-percentile high-frequency guard; not defect ground truth

input_unit: one fixed first-listed image per validation case
supervision: weak proxy: image inherits case label for validation ONLY; not definitive image suitability truth
quality_guard: Any flagged quality proxy blocks a suitable state; unsupported modes/extremes are uncertain
score_semantics: uncalibrated research gradability score, not probability of clinical adequacy
model_selection: Among validation pipelines: fewer false acceptances, then more correctly accepted gradable cases, then ROC-AUC. Selection is preliminary and uses the same validation cohort.
